summary: This bill reauthorizes the Project Safe Neighborhoods Grant Program through fiscal year 2030, expanding the allowable uses of funds to include hiring crime analysts, covering overtime costs for law enforcement and assistants, purchasing technology for crime reduction, and supporting multi-jurisdictional task forces, while also requiring annual transparency reports from the Attorney General.

scores.thoughts: This bill reauthorizes and expands the Project Safe Neighborhoods program, which is a nationwide initiative focused on reducing violent crime through law enforcement collaboration, strategic enforcement, and accountability. It explicitly funds hiring crime analysts, law enforcement assistants, overtime for officers and prosecutors, and technology for crime reduction, all of which strengthen policing and enforcement efforts. The bill also supports multi-jurisdictional task forces, further enhancing law enforcement capabilities.
